of.needed: whether environment uses L7 network policies with terminatingTLS that rely on ca.crt loading

original.statement: L7 network policy with terminatingTLS no longer loads the ca.crt key from secrets by default; set --use-full-tls-context=true to restore the old behavior.

decision.reason: [ev-b5190a359c10] says that L7 network policies with terminatingTLS no longer load `ca.crt` from the secret, and that setting `--use-full-tls-context=true` keeps the old behaviour. So the exposed environments are those where the flag is not set and an L7 terminatingTLS policy relies on a secret that contains `ca.crt`. The evidence gives no field paths or secret contents that a static check could test. That makes the flag-unset AND undecidable conjunction a fair statement of exposure: it is neither broader nor narrower than the text supports.
